title: Ice: Natural Earth 10 m glaciated areas and Antarctic ice shelves for the present, the dated margins of the last deglaciation (NADI-1, DATED-1) for the present's lowstand, and the glacial deposits of Cao et al. 2018 as a check on the atlas-derived past
license: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
note: The present day from Natural Earth: grounded ice (glaciers and ice sheets) and the floating Antarctic ice shelves as polygons in longitude/latitude; scripts/build_ice.py rasterises them onto the 0 Ma stop's texture grid. Every older grid takes the ice the 2016 PaleoAtlas paints on the nearest map, read by scripts/segment_paleoatlas.ice; no raster of the atlas is served. NADI-1 and DATED-1 give the present stop its dated lowstand: one field per thousand years of the last deglaciation, the North American and Eurasian margins over today's ice, at the sea level of each age from the Spratt & Lisiecki stack in sources/sealevel.json. The deposits asset is not drawn: it is the compilation of glacial deposits (tillites, diamictites) of Cao et al. 2018, rotated to each map's age to count how many fall inside the drawn ice; see docs/globe-viewer.md "Ice".

assets.cite: Dalton, A. S., Dulfer, H. E., Margold, M., Heyman, J., Clague, J. J., Froese, D. G., Gauthier, M. S., Hughes, A. L. C., Jennings, C. E., Norris, S. L., & Stoker, B. J. (2023). Deglaciation of the north American ice sheet complex in calendar years based on a comprehensive database of chronological data: NADI-1. Quaternary Science Reviews, 321, 108345. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.quascirev.2023.108345. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8161764
assets.note: North American Deglacial Isochrones: the Laurentide, Cordilleran and Innuitian margins every 500 years from 25 to 1 ka as optimal, minimum and maximum polygons in WGS84 longitude/latitude. Only the OPTIMAL files at whole thousands of years are read.

assets.cite: Hughes, A. L. C., Gyllencreutz, R., Lohne, Ø. S., Mangerud, J., & Svendsen, J. I. (2016). The last Eurasian ice sheets - a chronological database and time-slice reconstruction, DATED-1. Boreas, 45(1), 1-45. https://doi.org/10.1111/bor.12142. Data: https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.848117
assets.note: Time-slice margins of the British-Irish, Scandinavian and Svalbard-Barents-Kara ice sheets every thousand years from 25 to 10 ka (and 27, 30, 35, 40 ka) as most-credible, minimum and maximum polygons in a north-polar Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection on WGS84, which scripts/build_ice.py inverts. Only the mc files are read.

Only PresentDay_LithData_Scotese2008_410-0Ma/PresentDay_GlacialDeposits_Scotese2008_410-0Ma.shp is read: 394 localities with FROMAGE/TOAGE; plates are assigned here from the PALEOMAP polygons at 0 Ma, not taken from the file.
